subject: Materials Science
title: Chemical Recycling: Breaking Polymers Back Down
description: A tiny lesson with a big payoff: Chemical Recycling: Breaking Polymers Back Down.

hook.text: Mechanical recycling downgrades plastic each cycle. Chemical recycling resets it to new.

buildup.text: Chemical recycling breaks polymers back into monomers using heat or solvents.

discovery.text: Those recovered monomers polymerize again into virgin-quality plastic — a true closed loop.

twist.text: The process uses enormous energy — critics say it's too expensive to scale.

climax.text: If energy comes from renewables, chemical recycling could finally close the plastic loop.

punchline.text: Unmaking plastic takes as much cleverness as making it.

quiz.question: What is the main advantage of chemical over mechanical recycling?
options: It produces virgin-quality material instead of downcycled plastic
